name: Giant Rat
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 242 in v2, Giant Rat Traits.
heading: Giant Rat Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion from the printed v2 traits for the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
sourceDistinctions: The printed player block omits darkvision and a disease attack despite references to those in surrounding text. The portrait uses ordinary rat anatomy and the NPC’s actions require no tools.

name: Giant Scorpion
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: pp. 242–243 in v2, Giant Scorpion Traits.
heading: Giant Scorpion Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion from the printed v2 traits for the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
sourceDistinctions: The claw’s damage type is missing from the player text. Keelpin uses bludgeoning as a table ruling. Its grapple is a contest after a hit and uses the claw allowed by the trait. The build requires no hand-dependent equipment.

name: Giant Sea Horse
author: Tyler Kamstra
page: p. 243 in v2, Giant Sea Horse Traits.
heading: Giant Sea Horse Traits
provenance: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion from the printed v2 traits for the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
sourceDistinctions: Siltcrest uses Strength for the ram so it can trigger Charge under the 2014 rule for unarmed melee weapon attacks. The portrait uses ordinary seahorse anatomy and the build does not rely on object manipulation.

name: Giant Vulture

sourceDistinctions: The specific language line grants reading and understanding Common. Shearshade communicates through wing and head signals and uses neither speech nor writing.
